# t7.1 — Implementation detail

## Capability boundary

`PomCapability` exposes one method, `invoke(PomReadAction)`. Its discriminated action union is limited to dashboard menu visibility, search-result visibility, and menu-hidden observations. Results contain only the selected operation, a boolean observation, or a generic failure/denial; raw Page Object or Playwright errors are not returned.

The core wrapper enforces an enabled flag, explicit action allowlist, maximum of five calls per capability instance, and a 120-character input limit. It increments the call budget before awaiting the executor, so simultaneous calls cannot exceed the limit. Unknown configuration actions are rejected. The read-only executor is captured in a closure; the returned facade has no Page/POManager fields and is frozen.

The Cucumber integration binds those fixed actions to quiet, read-only methods on the existing dashboard Page Object. It never gives the Page Object to the runtime factory. `AgentRuntimeFactory` receives scenario identifiers and the optional safe facade only; `CucumberWorld.page` and `CucumberWorld.pageManager` are not copied into the runtime scope.

## Explicit configuration

The current hooks pass the capability only when all of these conditions hold:

1. `AGENTIC_TESTS_ENABLED=true`;
2. `AGENTIC_POM_CAPABILITIES_ENABLED=true`; and
3. `AGENTIC_POM_ALLOWED_ACTIONS` contains one or more recognized action names, such as `dashboard.verify-menu,dashboard.verify-menu-hidden`.

With the flags unset/false, the runtime factory receives no POM capability. The exact action names are validated; unsupported names fail closed. These flags do not configure a provider or make the default runtime operational.

- `src/agentic/contracts/pom-capability.ts` — typed action, policy, result, facade, and fixed executor contracts.
- `src/agentic/core/pom-capability.ts` — policy-checked dispatcher and allowlist parser.

- `docs/agentic-testing.md` — configuration and capability boundary documentation.

## Limitations

- No default agent runtime or model provider is implemented; the existing placeholder still fails clearly if agentic mode is enabled without an approved adapter.
- The new facade is supplementary and does not change scenario pass/fail, assertions, or step definitions.
- Browser-backed legacy behavior has not been demonstrated by this change; follow-up validation still requires an authorized environment.
